_note: Codex display content only. All stats (hp/speed/attack/...) live in enemies.json and are read at runtime — never duplicated here. name/review are {en, zh} pairs; item desc describes the engine effect (engine.js applyPowerup).

review.en: Cannon fodder with a work ethic — dies in one hit, yet carries your early drops.
review.zh: 炮灰中的劳模——一炮就碎，却承包了你前期的补给。

review.en: Weaves a lazy sine wave; more annoying than dangerous.
review.zh: 飘忽的正弦舞步，烦人有余，威胁不足。

review.en: The first foe that shoots back. Respect the lane it holds.
review.zh: 第一个会还手的家伙，它占的那条弹道值得尊重。

review.en: A drifting rock. It never chases you — you crash into it all by yourself.
review.zh: 一块会漂的石头。它不追你，是你自己撞上去的。

review.en: Parks at mid-field and snipes your row — move, or be moved.
review.zh: 停在半场瞄准你的航线——要么挪位，要么挪命。

review.en: Locks onto your altitude and homes in. Shake it off, don't outfly it.
review.zh: 咬住你的高度穷追不舍，靠变向甩，别硬飞。

review.en: Slow, tanky, and paints spirals of bullets you must thread through.
review.zh: 又慢又硬，吐出的螺旋弹幕得贴着缝钻。

review.en: A flying bulkhead fanning bullets — breach it before it blocks the sky.
review.zh: 会扇形吐弹的空中路障，趁它没堵死天空先拆掉。

review.en: Fast, twitchy, one hit from dead — and one bump from killing you.
review.zh: 急速乱窜，一碰即碎——也一碰即要你命。

review.en: Crawls in and unfurls a bullet wall with one gap. Find it, live there.
review.zh: 慢吞吞摊开一面只留一道缺口的弹墙，找到缝就守住。

review.en: Glides in, hovers, then kamikaze-dives your row.
review.zh: 滑进来悬停片刻，然后朝你的航线自杀式俯冲。

review.en: Advance, halt, X-cross, repeat. Learn the rhythm and it's a box of loot.
review.zh: 走、停、十字弹，循环往复。踩准节奏，它就是一只宝箱。

review.en: Its aimed shots come absurdly fast — kill it first, or hug the gaps.
review.zh: 狙击弹快得离谱，优先点掉，或者老老实实贴缝躲。

review.en: A quicker, hungrier chaser with real HP. Never let it get personal.
review.zh: 更快更耐咬的追踪者，千万别让它贴近身。

review.en: A treasure chest with cannons — tough, but pays out the best drops.
review.zh: 长了炮台的宝箱——皮厚，但掉落最肥。

review.en: Mid-level gatekeeper. Beat it and a heal drops on the spot.
review.zh: 关卡中段的守门人，打倒当场掉一口回血。

review.en: The second-half gatekeeper — spiral and curtain, a double greeting.
review.zh: 后半程守门人——螺旋弹加弹帘，双重问候。

review.en: Wave one's graduation exam: five-way fans, aimed shots, bursts.
review.zh: 第一波次的毕业考：五向扇形、狙击、连发三件套。

review.en: Hatches drones mid-fight while fanning bullets. Crowd control required.
review.zh: 一边扇形撒弹一边孵小飞机，考验你的清理效率。

review.en: Same mother, meaner temper: spirals, spawns, seven-way fans.
review.zh: 同一艘母舰，脾气更坏：螺旋、召崽、七向扇形全招呼。

review.en: A battleship the size of your screen; the nine-way fan owns the corners.
review.zh: 几乎占满屏幕的战列舰，九向扇形逼你贴边走位。

review.en: Bullet curtains with a wasp escort. The gap moves — so should you.
review.zh: 弹帘开路还带黄蜂护卫，缺口会挪，你也要跟着挪。

review.en: Faster cycle, faster bullets, same nightmare.
review.zh: 循环更快、子弹更快，噩梦还是那个噩梦。

review.en: Its blade head throws curtains, fans and kamikaze mantas.
review.zh: 刀盘旋转间弹帘、扇形弹齐出，还会放出俯冲蝠鲼。

review.en: More HP, tighter spirals, spider escorts. Bring your best gun.
review.zh: 血更厚、螺旋更密，还带蜘蛛护卫——火力全开吧。

review.en: An eleven-way fan is not an attack pattern, it's weather.
review.zh: 十一向扇形已经不是弹幕，是天灾。

review.en: The final wall: every pattern, every escort, 430 HP of no.
review.zh: 终局之墙：所有弹幕、所有护卫，430 点血量写满了「不」。

desc.en: Weapon level +1 (max 3). At max level it converts to 200 points.
desc.zh: 火力等级 +1（上限 3 级），满级时转化为 200 分。

review.en: The cornerstone of every run — early pickups snowball.
review.zh: 每一次通关的基石——前期捡到就是滚雪球。

review.en: Crowd eraser — loses to single targets, shines in swarms.
review.zh: 清杂神器——打单体略亏，进鱼群血赚。

desc.en: Piercing beam for 10 seconds, damage 2, cuts through whole rows.
desc.zh: 10 秒穿透激光，伤害 2，整排贯穿。

review.en: Line the convoy up and delete it in one pass.
review.zh: 把敌人排成一串，一梭子全带走。

review.en: The greenest number in the game. Never skip it.
review.zh: 全游戏最治愈的数字，路过别放过。

desc.en: +1 special charge (max 5) for the screen-clearing beam.
desc.zh: 大招充能 +1（上限 5 格），用于清屏激光。

review.en: Insurance against bullet hell — five blocks, five escapes.
review.zh: 弹幕地狱的保险单——五格就是五条退路。

desc.en: Absorbs 3 hits; shield hits cause no knockback timer.
desc.zh: 吸收 3 次伤害，且受击不触发无敌硬直。

review.en: Turns three mistakes into three nothing-burgers.
review.zh: 把三次失误变成三次无事发生。

desc.en: +12 homing missiles (max 20), damage 3, fly straight through enemy fire.
desc.zh: 追踪导弹 +12 枚（上限 20），伤害 3，直穿敌方子弹。

review.en: Fire-and-forget luxury — your aim line can retire early.
review.zh: 发射后不管的奢侈品——瞄准线可以提前退休。

desc.en: For 10 seconds volleys fly out and curve back, piercing on both legs and shredding enemy fire en route.
desc.zh: 10 秒内子弹飞出后折返，去、回两程均穿透伤害，途中还会削掉敌方子弹。

review.en: Park beside a boss and let the return leg do the filing.
review.zh: 贴着 Boss 站桩，返程那一刀最疼。

desc.en: +1 escort drone (max 2) that volleys with you — missile launches included. Lost on death.
desc.zh: 僚机 +1 台（上限 2），随每次开火齐射——连发射导弹时也不例外。坠机后清空。

review.en: Two little shadows doing half your paperwork.
review.zh: 两道小影子，替你分担一半的火力输出。

desc.en: +1 spare ship (max 5); at full strength it converts to 500 points.
desc.zh: 备用机体 +1（上限 5 台）；满编时转化为 500 分。

review.en: The rarest glint on the field — always worth the detour.
review.zh: 全场最稀有的一闪——绕路也值得捡。
